goal: Harden cross-chat package production after two reproduced live defects: a Santander package was produced before the exact first-party requisition was proven actionable, and the DraftKings resume drifted from the canonical gold family and leaked internal-system language. Make package-time first-party re-verification and gold-artifact-based spawning explicit fail-closed operating requirements without changing Candidate Truth, Match Truth, qualification logic, schemas, or runtime product code.
acceptance_conditions: immediately before Claude drafting, DOCX mutation, cover-letter drafting, or any other meaningful package work, the exact current first-party employer requisition must be re-opened in the current operating session and must still establish matching requisition identity plus substantive current job-description content and a current actionable application route/instruction

a blank or contentless requisition shell, JavaScript-only page with no recoverable current JD content, generic careers/search redirect, page-not-found, expired/closed page, identity mismatch, or missing current application route fails the package gate; discovery indexes, aggregators, cached snippets, prior captures, chat summaries, and memory cannot rescue it

when the package-time actionability recheck fails, no resume, cover letter, or other candidate-facing package may be generated or revised for that role; preserve historical analysis if useful and report the current role as non-actionable/verification-required using existing truth axes rather than inventing a new schema enum

resume spawning must use the exact current Bora gold-quality DOCX artifact as the starting document when that artifact is available; verify its SHA-256 against the canonical gold-reference record before cloning and making bounded content edits

a chat or agent must not reconstruct the gold family from scratch with a fresh document/template, ad-hoc tables, margins, typography, or section grammar merely by reading doctrine; if the exact gold artifact is unavailable or its hash does not match, stop with GOLD_REFERENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED rather than improvising a new resume template

candidate-facing package text must not expose internal Career OS/governance/evidence-system/implementation-control language such as human approval, operating system, fail-closed, queue-level eligibility, deterministic boundary, Candidate Truth, or similar internal mechanics unless the exact term is independently job-relevant and recruiter-natural; otherwise translate the supported work into ordinary professional American English

before delivery to Bora, package QA must explicitly reject a PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY heading, noncanonical section order, noncanonical Title | Employer work grammar, missing required gold-family hyperlink objects, rendered overflow/clipping/overlap, sub-92-percent meaningful utilization, or other material gold-family structural drift unless an explicit employer format instruction requires a documented exception

the new machine-readable gate record must cite Santander as the reproduced package-before-actionability failure and DraftKings as the reproduced gold-family/internal-jargon drift failure, without turning either role's substantive job or resume content into universal Candidate Truth

AGENTS.md, BLUEPRINT.md, .cursor/rules/resume.mdc, and the machine-readable gate record must express one consistent operating chain so a fresh chat recovering the repo receives the same fail-closed package rules
no Candidate Truth, Match Truth, qualification/pursuit logic, immigration logic, schema, runtime product code, protected resume master, or end-to-end generator implementation is changed
stop_conditions: hardening would require inventing a new persisted job/actionability enum instead of using existing role_status/source_verification_status semantics
hardening would require committing Bora's personal gold DOCX binary into the repository without separate explicit authorization
hardening would change Candidate Truth, Match Truth, qualification/pursuit logic, immigration logic, schemas, runtime product code, or protected resume master

hardening would weaken the current first-party actionability gate, gold reference grammar, 92 percent page-utilization floor, DOCX-first rule, real-hyperlink requirement, or truth-lineage requirements
